flashcards.back: The application of Generative AI to software engineering, involving the use of AI-powered tools to design, develop, and test software systems.
A technique that combines retrieval and generation to produce more accurate and informative outputs, by retrieving relevant information and generating text based on that information.
The use of AI tools to assist in the development process, including learning, designing, debugging, implementing, testing, and documenting software systems.

Specific technical challenges that teams must select and implement, such as retrieval strategies, prompt improvement, and interactive visualizations, to demonstrate their technical skills and creativity.
Metrics and data that must be exposed by the application to demonstrate its usage of AI, including number of requests, token usage, and other relevant metrics.
